WITH quarterly_financials AS (
  SELECT 
    ticker,
    calendar_year,
    calendar_quarter_num,
    metric,
    value
  FROM comp_financials
  WHERE 
    calendar_quarter_num IS NOT NULL
    AND ticker IN ('AVGO','NVDA','AMD','INTC','MU','QCOM','TXN')
    AND metric IN ('Revenue', 'Gross Profit', 'Operating Income', 'Net Income')
    AND calendar_year >= EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 2
    AND value IS NOT NULL
),
annual_aggregates AS (
  SELECT 
    ticker,
    calendar_year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Revenue' THEN value END) AS revenue,
    SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Gross Profit' THEN value END) AS gross_profit,
    SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Operating Income' THEN value END) AS operating_income,
    SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Net Income' THEN value END) AS net_income
  FROM quarterly_financials
  GROUP BY ticker, calendar_year
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Revenue' THEN value END) > 0
),
margins AS (
  SELECT 
    ticker,
    calendar_year,
    revenue,
    (gross_profit / revenue) * 100.0 AS gross_margin,
    (operating_income / revenue) * 100.0 AS operating_margin,
    (net_income / revenue) * 100.0 AS net_margin
  FROM annual_aggregates
  WHERE revenue > 0
),
peer_averages AS (

  p.peer_avg_gross_margin,
  p.peer_avg_operating_margin,

details.analysis:
TL;DR: Broadcom’s reported margins in the SQL results are materially higher than peers — gross margin ≈86% (2023) and a pronounced spike to ~102% in 2025, with operating and net margins likewise well above peer averages. The chart shows a sharp upward move into 2025, while industry headlines point to strong semiconductor demand from AI but cite a more conservative recent gross margin (~67%) for Broadcom [1][2][3].

Key points:
- SQL: AVGO gross margin was 85.74% (2023), 77.72% (2024) and an anomalous 101.90% (2025); peers averaged ~45.9% (2023) rising to ~73.8% (2025) — Broadcom remains well above peers across years.
- SQL: AVGO operating margin was 56.68% (2023), 29.12% (2024) and 61.33% (2025) versus peer averages of ~9.1%, 18.6% and 31.7% respectively.
- SQL: AVGO net margin was ~50.06% (2023), 8.70% (2024) and 53.38% (2025) versus peer averages of ~8.20%, 14.29% and 28.12%.
- Chart takeaway: the multi-metric line chart shows a pronounced margin rebound into 2025, driven by the same jump visible in the SQL aggregates.
- Headline context: industry demand from AI and data centers supports margin expansion industry-wide, and third-party sources report Broadcom’s recent gross margin

details.sql:
WITH quarterly_financials AS (
  SELECT 
    ticker,
    calendar_year,
    calendar_quarter_num,
    metric,
    value
  FROM comp_financials
  WHERE 
    calendar_quarter_num IS NOT NULL
    AND ticker IN ('AVGO','NVDA','AMD','INTC','MU','QCOM','TXN')
    AND metric IN ('Revenue', 'Gross Profit', 'Operating Income', 'Net Income')
    AND calendar_year >= EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 2
    AND value IS NOT NULL
),
annual_aggregates AS (
  SELECT 
    ticker,
    calendar_year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Revenue' THEN value END) AS revenue,
    SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Gross Profit' THEN value END) AS gross_profit,
    SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Operating Income' THEN value END) AS operating_income,
    SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Net Income' THEN value END) AS net_income
  FROM quarterly_financials
  GROUP BY ticker, calendar_year
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Revenue' THEN value END) > 0
),
margins AS (
  SELECT 
    ticker,
    calendar_year,
    revenue,
    (gross_profit / revenue) * 100.0 AS gross_margin,
    (operating_income / revenue) * 100.0 AS operating_margin,
    (net_income / revenue) * 100.0 AS net_margin
  FROM annual_aggregates
  WHERE revenue > 0
),
peer_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    calendar_year,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ticker != 'AVGO' THEN gross_margin END) AS peer_avg_gross_margin,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ticker != 'AVGO' THEN operating_margin END) AS peer_avg_operating_margin,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ticker != 'AVGO' THEN net_margin END) AS peer_avg_net_margin
  FROM margins
  GROUP BY calendar_year
)
SELECT 
  m.calendar_year,
  m.ticker,
  m.gross_margin AS company_gross_margin,
  m.operating_margin AS company_operating_margin,
  m.net_margin AS company_net_margin,
  p.peer_avg_gross_margin,
  p.peer_avg_operating_margin,
  p.peer_avg_net_margin
FROM margins m
JOIN peer_averages p ON m.calendar_year = p.calendar_year
WHERE m.ticker = 'AVGO'
ORDER BY m.calendar_year
LIMIT 500
